entries.039706f54ec0253b: A reportable segment in which the Group invests its own money in listed stocks, unlisted venture companies, various funds, domestic real estate and others to earn revenue. It is operated by the consolidated subsidiary Aizawa Investments Co., Ltd. The securities report positions this business as an important business that contributes to stabilizing consolidated results and improving asset profitability, and states that it conducts medium- to long-term investment in growing companies in Japan and overseas and in companies expected to deliver stable returns, investment in promising venture companies, investment in venture capital funds, private equity funds, private debt funds and others, and direct investment in domestic real estate with residences mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area (rental income). For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥810 million and segment loss was ¥722 million. The report states that operating revenue decreased 65.4% year on year to ¥832 million (including internal operating revenue between segments) as revenue from invested funds (distributions and others) recorded in the previous fiscal year decreased, and that an operating loss resulted from valuation losses on funds investing in unlisted assets and impairment losses on operational investment securities, but that gains and losses on sales of investment securities brought profit before income taxes to ¥2,558 million (down 37.3%), contributing to securing consolidated net income.

entries.16b2f18da8941d0b: The business of a face-to-face securities firm that sells stocks, investment trusts and other products to individual customers, and the category with the largest operating revenue from external customers of the 3 reportable segments. It is operated by the consolidated subsidiary Aizawa Securities Co., Ltd., whose operating revenue (excluding internal transactions between consolidated companies) exceeds 10% of consolidated operating revenue. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥19,986 million and segment profit was ¥1,054 million (up 313.2% year on year). The securities report states that the reasons were an increase in stock brokerage commissions in a favorable market environment, and growth in the balance of assets under custody in stock-type products (investment trusts and wrap products), which increased trust fees. This category is promoting "Goal-Based Approach (GBA) sales," which stays with customers over the long term to achieve the "goals" of their life plans; the report states that it was piloted at some branches from April 2025 and will be extended to all branches from April 2026. As of the end of March 2026, total assets under custody were ¥2,385.5 billion (up ¥419.3 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year), of which assets under custody in stock-type products were ¥563.9 billion (up ¥140.6 billion). Assets under custody in the "platform business," which works with financial instruments intermediary service providers (IFA firms) that do not have financial product sales as their main business and with deposit-taking financial institutions, were ¥365.7 billion (up ¥92.6 billion).
